text: My regular dental clinic. The clinic is clean and new. The staff are lovely and helpful. There are many doctors, but sometimes it is quite difficult to make an appointment. You have to make an appointment well in advance.
The doctor was a little heavy-handed, but very attentive and thorough. Everything was explained in an easy-to-understand way.

Overall, this is a good dental clinic. The reception staff provided excellent service, including scheduling appointments and providing advice. The dentist was gentle and painless. I had my teeth cleaned, filled, and had my wisdom teeth removed. I'm still considering getting braces.
The follow-up is excellent, and the dentist is attentive. After my wisdom teeth removal, the bleeding stopped slowly. I called for a consultation and received good feedback. If I were still near the clinic, I would have gone back to see him. However, when I got home, the dentist and staff called to ask if I was feeling better and if the bleeding had stopped.

4 Reasons Why We Chose to Have Our Dental Treatment Here:

1.) The doctor is skilled, attentive, and most importantly, egoistic!!
**This is very important to me. > There are skilled doctors everywhere, but a skilled doctor who isn't egoistic is highly recommended here. This clinic ticks all the boxes.**
2.) The clinic caters to customer needs efficiently, without dragging things out, delaying treatment, or making you feel like you're "begging" for treatment.
3.) There are no long waiting times.
4.) All staff perform their duties well, meeting the clinic's high standards.

In short, we give it a perfect 10 out of 10.
"I encourage you to give it a try. A good clinic with good doctors deserves to be here to take care of us for a long time."
